sapNotes.title: AI Core: deployment rejected with quota exceeded in region eu10
sapNotes.keywords: quota exceeded eu10 deployment rejected resource group inference
sapNotes.description: New deployments or inference scale-ups fail with a quota error although usage looks moderate. The quota is set per resource group and region.
sapNotes.solution: Request a temporary quota increase for the resource group in eu10 through the quota service request, then set a usage alert at 80 percent of the quota. Remove idle deployments that still reserve capacity.

sapNotes.title: Document AI: empty header fields for scanned multi-page invoices
sapNotes.keywords: scanned invoice multi page empty fields vat id extraction header
sapNotes.description: Header fields such as the VAT ID or invoice date come back empty for scanned multi-page invoices, while line items are found.
sapNotes.solution: Enable page-orientation correction in the extraction schema and add the header fields to the schema version used by the channel. Re-run the affected documents; no new model training is needed.

sapNotes.title: Ariba: approval workflow does not start for a cost centre range
sapNotes.keywords: approval workflow not triggering cost centre approval rule validity
sapNotes.description: Requisitions for certain cost centres skip the approval flow or never start it.
sapNotes.solution: Check the validity window and the cost centre range of the approval rule; rules copied from a previous year keep their old end date. Activate the corrected rule and resubmit the requisition.

sapNotes.title: Joule skill returns an empty list for open purchase orders
sapNotes.keywords: joule skill empty result purchase orders authorization technical user odata
sapNotes.description: A Joule skill that reads purchase orders answers with an empty list or says nothing was found.
sapNotes.solution: Check the authorization scope of the technical user behind the skill destination and the date filter of the OData query. After the fix, clear the skill cache and test with a known purchase order.

sapNotes.title: Commerce Cloud: storefront search empty after catalog import
sapNotes.keywords: storefront search no results catalog import index empty
sapNotes.description: After a catalog import the storefront search finds nothing and the index shows no documents.
sapNotes.solution: Run a full re-index for the affected index type after the import and verify that the import synchronisation job finished with status FINISHED before the index job starts.
